description: Sign in with a cloud account to apply for an enterprise licence, then upgrade to the enterprise edition.

machine.previousDescription: This machine has the previous enterprise edition (the Python one), not yet moved to the new enterprise edition.
machine.licensedDescription: Enterprise licence obtained; not upgraded yet.
machine.openDescription: Review the current license information, submit applications, and track approval status.
machine.previousNote: The enterprise edition is a separate installer now, and the previous one gets no more releases. The open part keeps upgrading with flocks update; the previous edition's audit logs, security configuration, user management and prompt redaction pages come back with the new enterprise edition.
machine.licensedNote: The licence is saved on this machine and will be used after upgrading to the enterprise edition.
machine.lapsedNote: The licence on this machine is no longer valid. Once it is renewed or a new one is issued, the new enterprise edition goes by that one.
machine.openNote: The enterprise edition is a separate installer: its first start copies the open edition’s data into its bundled PostgreSQL, and everything is used as before.

licence.syncChanged: Synced with Console: the new licence terms are in effect.
licence.syncUnchanged: Synced with Console: nothing has changed for this licence.
licence.invalidHint: This licence is no longer valid and the new enterprise edition will not carry it over. If it was renewed at Console, sync to get the new expiry; otherwise apply again or contact us to have it reissued.

apply.title: Flocks Pro Upgrade Application
apply.signInFirst: Log in console account before applying for upgrade.

problems.phone: Not a phone number: 6 to 15 digits, a country code starting with +

apply.pendingSubmission: The last submission got no answer from Console, so it may have arrived. Sending again gets it back first; nothing is sent twice.
apply.withdrawConfirm: Withdraw this application? You would have to apply again.

upgrade.title: Enterprise updates
upgrade.currentPrevious: This is the previous enterprise edition {{version}}. The service restarts automatically during the upgrade.
upgrade.currentOpen: The service restarts automatically during the upgrade.
upgrade.whatChanges: After the upgrade the program is in {{root}} and the data directory stays the same; the first start copies the existing data into the bundled PostgreSQL, and the original data files are kept but no longer updated; the machine’s licence is carried over. flocks start|stop|restart|status|logs|update keep managing the service.
upgrade.whatChangesWindows: After the upgrade the program is in {{root}} and the enterprise edition starts at boot as the "FlocksPro Core" service; the open edition’s data is copied for the enterprise edition, and the original directory is kept but no longer updated; the machine’s licence is carried over. Windows asks for administrator confirmation during the installation.
upgrade.systemd: This open edition is managed by systemd. Download the installer and run the command shown here with root privileges.
upgrade.prepare: {{account}} cannot write {{root}} yet: run this once as root, then come back.
upgrade.loginFirst: Log in console account before checking for a new version.

progress.installing: Upgrading to {{version}}. The open edition stops, and the enterprise edition’s first start migrates the data, which can take a few minutes; the page refreshes automatically when the installation finishes.
progress.restarting: The open edition has stopped and the enterprise edition is starting for the first time (moving the data). The page reloads if it listens on this address; otherwise open the address the installer printed.
progress.finished: The new enterprise edition {{version}} is installed; reload the page.
progress.failed: The install did not finish and the open edition keeps running; the installer output below says why.
progress.command: The installer is downloaded. Run, as root:
progress.commandPrepare: The installer is downloaded. First let this account have the install directory (as root), then run the installer:

errors.wentBack: The last upgrade did not finish, so this machine went back to the version it had before. Its data and its service are intact. To try again, click the new-version mark next to the version at the bottom left.
errors.load: Could not read this machine's state
errors.login: Could not start the Console sign-in
errors.logout: Could not log out of the console account

callback.missingConsoleLoginId: console_login_id is missing; the sign-in cannot be finished.
